references.text: Parallel description of the pillars and sockets for the north side of the courtyard with identical measurements and materials
Describes the silver bands and hooks on the pillars around the courtyard
Continuation of the description of the courtyard pillars on the north side with the same construction
Summarizes that all the pillars in the courtyard had silver bands and silver hooks
Mentions the use of bronze sockets under the planks of the tabernacle
Describes pillars with gold hooks and bronze sockets, showing a similar construction pattern
The connection shows the correspondence between God's commandment and the actual execution of the courtyard of the tabernacle.
Specifies that the north side was built according to the same strict material requirements as the rest of the courtyard.
Contrasts the choice of materials (gold vs. silver) to show the hierarchical difference between the courtyard and the sanctuary itself.
